description: Organizational continuity for AI agents. Make AI work resumable, reviewable, and provable across agents. The task outlives the chat: OrgX lets the next agent continue from the decisions, artifacts, approvals, owners, and proof the last agent left behind. Users can search company context, inspect initiatives, review pending decisions, scaffold work, delegate agent tasks, and view interactive widgets for status and follow-up actions.

defaultPrompt: What decisions are waiting on me in OrgX?
